# Security Policy

## Supported versions

| Version | Supported |
| --- | --- |
| 1.0.x | ✅ |

## Reporting a vulnerability

**Do not open a public issue for security vulnerabilities.**

Use GitHub's private vulnerability reporting:
<https://github.com/Hilbras/Keystone/security/advisories/new>

Include:

- Affected version/commit and deployment context
- Step-by-step reproduction or proof of concept
- Impact assessment

You will receive an acknowledgment within 48 hours. We coordinate disclosure
with a target patch release within 90 days, and credit reporters by default
(opt out at any time).

See [docs/SECURITY.md](../docs/SECURITY.md) for the full security model,
hardening checklist, and operational guidance.
